layers.message: Add stockroom CLI with export and import commands
Record scope and design for export --since
Add --since filter to export and record verification

prompt.utterance: Document the import command; it's a separate feature from the current work.

graderOnly: The active cycle's request is the export --since filter; it does not cover the import command, whose only documentation is a one-line entry in README.md.
WorkflowState TESTING is owned by Tester; the persisted Active Work.BlockedOn is Tester's scenario-budget question for its Frame 2 test correction.
Recovery is nested: Frame 1 (TESTING -> DEVELOPING, IMPLEMENTATION) and Frame 2 (DEVELOPING -> TESTING, VERIFICATION), both with RerunThrough NONE.
The user has not asked to cancel, replace, or rework the active cycle; the working tree is clean.

all.why: the active cycle stays with its owner
pending fields are not overwritten to queue the separate request
no project documentation, comment, or docstring edits
no documentation record or other cycle record written

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the verification report records the established test command passing (7 tests) on the committed sources in a UTC runner

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ESM CLI 'stockroom' with export and import commands, README.md (import has a one-line mention only), docs/export.md, node:test suites. 50-design: Auditor CONTEXT.md, cycle scope (AC-001..AC-004, non-goal: import command) and technical design, STATE at DEVELOPING. 60-implementation: --since implementation in src/export.js and src/cli.js, Tester's since scenarios in test/export.test.js, development plan (DEV-001 reopened IN_PROGRESS, DEV-002 DONE, Developer Suspended Assignment for Frame 2), verification report (BLOCKED, Assessment Purpose CORRECTION, Tester Suspended Assignment FULL for Frame 1), and final STATE: TESTING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Handoff FAILURE DEVELOPING->TESTING VERIFICATION, two recovery frames (Frame 1 TESTING->DEVELOPING IMPLEMENTATION; Frame 2 DEVELOPING->TESTING VERIFICATION; both RerunThrough NONE), Active Work.BlockedOn holding Tester's scenario-budget question. The verification report's CORRECTION purpose is required by check.mjs for a scoped Tester correction frame and was set by Tester, not the role under test. Assertion 0 is graded field-by-field on STATE.md; assertion 1 by unchanged globs over documentation and cycle records; assertion 2 by the judge.
